text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp has finally come to an end…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It looks like we got through without a hitch.
choice_data_list: We got in a lot of good training.
We got in a lot of good training.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Indeed. We're ready for the Shuka Sho. Let's keep up this pace once we're back.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member
text_block_list.text: Vice President! Some students aren't here for roll call!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What?! Why must they make things difficult right until the last minute?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Air Groove seemed busy from start to finish, it was definitely a productive summer camp!
